title: How to Build a Niche Job Board That Makes Money in 2026
summary: Build a custom niche job board with job listings, employer accounts, and Stripe payments — no developer needed. Database, auth, and hosting included free.
body_markdown: Six proven revenue streams beyond per-listing fees: employer subscriptions ($199–$499/month for unlimited listings), resume database access ($299/month), newsletter sponsorships ($500/month), featured placements ($499 per featured slot), recruitment agency partnerships (commission on hires), and job alert email sponsorships. Most successful niche job boards layer 3–4 of these on top of per-listing revenue.
